title: We're going to the swimming pool, right?
scene: 周末计划，他一项项确认。

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: What's the plan for Saturday, buddy?

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: We're going to the swimming pool, right?

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: The big pool or the small pool?

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: The big pool. And you're bringing your float.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: After the pool, can we get ice cream?

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: Swim a lot first — then yes, ice cream!

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: We're going to swim so fast! Deal!

variations: "the pool" 换 "the park"；"ice cream" 换 "juice"。
